clips.title: The story
paras: The Twilight Outpost is a fortified encampment of the Twilight's Hammer cult nestled in the southwestern sands of Silithus. Located just northwest of the ancient Scarab Wall, it serves as a staging ground where cultists conduct dark rituals to commune with and summon elemental horrors.

Tucked away in the southwestern reaches of Silithus, the Twilight Outpost serves as one of several major cultist strongholds dotting the desert wastes. Positioned in the shadow of the colossal Scarab Wall and west of the Bronzebeard Encampment, the outpost teems with fanatical Twilight Avengers, Geolords, and Stonecallers. Under the command of leaders like Twilight Keeper Exeter and the rare Twilight Lord Everun, these zealots toil tirelessly in service of their maddening apocalyptic masters.

Scattered throughout the encampment are mysterious Wind Stones, varying in size from Lesser to Greater conduits. Through the use of enchanted cultist regalia and foul incantations, the cult utilizes these monoliths to tear into the elemental planes, dragging forth Abyssal commanders and elemental lords. For adventurers brave enough to infiltrate their ranks, disrupting these summonings remains one of the primary means to strike back against the cult's influence in the desert.
